name: CSN 3001 老太太受伤 2座乘客重伤

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 001, a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are cruising at 9200 meters, squawking 3625.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 001，从广州飞往北京，在 9200 米巡航，应答机 3625。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3001, maintaining 9200 meters, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN3001，保持 9200 米，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, maintain present level.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，广州管制，雷达识别，保持当前高度。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 001, there was a severe ride report by previous pilot at 10700 meters, what's your intention?
B: Tell the controller that you'd like to climb to 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 001，前机飞行员报告 10700 米有严重颠簸，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 11300 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, roger, climb to and maintain 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，收到，爬升并保持 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11300 meters, CSN3001.

cards.audioText: B: During climb, the purser reports that an old lady was injured, report it to Guangzhou Control and request descend to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，乘务长报告一位老太太受伤，向广州管制报告并请求下降至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3001, the purser reports that an old lady was injured, request descend to 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN3001，乘务长报告一位老太太受伤，请求下降至 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, roger, descend to maintain 8400 meters, expedite descent until passing 10100 due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，收到，下降并保持 8400 米，因穿越飞机，通过 10100 前加快下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to maintain 8400 meters, expedite descent until passing 10100 meters, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 8400 米，通过 10100 米前加快下降，CSN3001。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 001, when able, say you are further intention.
B: Tell Guangzhou Control that 2 passengers in Seat 35 Lima and 35 Hotel were seriously injured, and you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 001，能够时说明进一步意图。
B：告诉广州管制 35 Lima 和 35 Hotel 座位的 2 名旅客严重受伤，你想备降武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: 2 passengers in Seat 35L and 35H were seriously injured and we'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 35L 和 35H 座位的 2 名旅客严重受伤，我们想备降武汉机场，CSN3001。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, roger, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9, we have informed them of your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，收到，联系武汉管制118.9，我们已告知他们你的情况。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 8100 meters, you are over IKUBA, squawking 3625, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 8100 米，在 IKUBA 上空，应答机 3625，与武汉管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN3001, maintaining 8100 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN3001，保持 8100 米，IKUBA 上空，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, Wuhan Control, radar contact, continue descent to 6300 meters, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，武汉管制，雷达识别，继续下降并保持 6300 米，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot。
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 6300 meters, turn right, direct to ZF, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 6300 米，右转，直飞 ZF，CSN3001。

cards.audioText: C: China 7001, descend and maintain 4500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China 7001，下降并保持 4500 米，联系武汉进近119.25。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 4500 meters, you have received the ATIS November, tell your situation to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Zulu Foxtrot 上空，保持 4500 米，已收到 ATIS November，向武汉进近说明你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN3001, over ZF, maintaining 4500 meters, information N.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN3001，ZF 上空，保持 4500 米，通播 N。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 001, Wuhan Approach, roger, do you require any emergency services?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach you need ambulance and first aid upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 001，武汉进近，收到，你需要任何应急服务吗？
B：告诉武汉进近你抵达时需要救护车和急救。
cards.referenceText: Request ambulance and first aid upon arrival, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求抵达时救护车和急救，CSN3001。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, we will relay your message to the related parties, you are number 1, now turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，我们会把你的信息转告相关单位，你是第 1 架，现在左转航向 120，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 120，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN3001。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, runway 36R, cleared to land, the ambulance will be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，跑道 36R，可以落地，救护车将在跑道附近准备好。

cards.audioText: B: You are unfamiliar with Wuhan Airport, contact Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you need a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你不熟悉武汉机场，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你需要引导车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3001, we are unfamiliar with Wuhan Airport, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN3001，我们不熟悉武汉机场，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 001, when vacated, follow the follow-me car to gate 213.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 001，脱离跑道后，跟随引导车到 213 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: When vacated, follow the follow-me car to gate 213, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 脱离跑道后，跟随引导车到 213 号登机口，CSN3001。
